title: Gregory W NDE 5036
content: I was living with my parents at the time this experience took place. I was in my bedroom sleeping and slipped into a diabetic insulin reaction. I did not wake up when these occurred and would many times come out of my sleep with my mom and/or dad hovering over me, calling my name. I'd have these pounding headaches and it would take several hours for me to feel normal again. I find it interesting with this particular reaction; I had no headache or long recovery. After the experience I felt normal or as I had just woken out of a deep sleep. Here's what happened. I was asleep and fell into an insulin reaction. I don't remember the exact time but do know that it was toward early morning probably around 4:00 am. I'd had several incidents similar to this and had shared these with my mother. On this night, it suddenly felt as if there were a great warmth around me and then a great burst of light. The light appeared to be not like the sunlight but a very bright, white light. It was pure and had no darkness in the light. I didn't seen any being though at this point. I began to move and noted that I was moving under my own control. I was sucked up into a tunnel and towards a brighter light. Moving through the tunnel did not take long, there was no pain and when I reached the end, I was propelled to a place that I cannot describe in words. I had been brought up in a religious environment and knew something about these things, but was not prepared for what I saw. I remember looking down to see I had feet, as it seemed that I was floating. When I looked, I saw I had feet and then concluded that something really weird was happening to me. Again there was no pain, I had no feeling of any type but was able to think clearly. I came to a place that had a green field of grass and as I looked into the distance (not too far but a bit) I saw the most beautiful sight. On a slight incline there was a city with walls so high I could hardly look over to see any sky at the top of the wall. I was moving slowly towards the city not at a fast pace but steadily and was able to get a good look at the walls. I noticed that there were three gates. Then I notice that I could look right through the walls and that there were gates on all four walls. The spacing between the gates was perfect and then I noticed the foundation and the construction of the wall. I'm red/green colorblind and am visually impaired. Yet, I saw twelve different colors that made up the wall. The colors where not blended but were clearly defined and each was the same height as the next. I also noted that the content or the making of the walls was solid stone and then realized that it was pure stone. (It took me a bit to figure out what this was. I didn't realize this until after the experience, but have concluded that the stone was so pure it was like glass!) I looked into the city and saw streets of solid gold. I then noticed beings and at that point felt a presence at the back of me. I was not afraid but could not move. I simply stood there and waited. The being approached me and I realized it was a celestial being. I was overpowered with great adoration, respect and thankfulness. I was not prepared for what I was going to be told. I never saw this being, but knew who it was. I felt a touch on my shoulder and then a voice. 'I need to send you back, your work is not done on earth yet,' the voice said. It's amazing to me. I was not disappointed nor did I have any resentment. I simply said, 'I'll go.' The voice then told me more. I cannot print that here but can tell this: There is a time coming very soon, in which I will be required to follow through with a task that will help with the preparing of the end of time. I don't know that time or day, but have very specific direction on what must be done. I then left the city and within a short time was back in my body. I awoke out of the reaction and as I stated above had no aftershock at all.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt a great warmth around him followed by a great burst of bright, pure white light.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He said he was 'sucked up into a tunnel' toward a brighter light; movement did not take long and there was no pain.

arrival.other_being_detail: He described a 'celestial being' he never visually saw but 'knew who it was,' and heard a voice after feeling a touch on his shoulder.

environment.environment_other_detail: Green field of grass; a walled city with very high walls and gates; walls made of very pure stone 'like glass'; streets of solid gold; he perceived twelve distinct colors in the wall.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he would soon be required to follow through with a task that will help prepare for 'the end of time' (he said he had very specific direction but did not share details).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Brought up in a religious environment (not specified).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Warmth and burst of light, then movement under own control, then tunnel toward brighter light, then arrival in a field and approach to a walled city, then encounter with a celestial presence/voice telling him to return, then rapid return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported perceiving twelve distinct colors in the wall despite being red/green colorblind and visually impaired; he never visually saw the 'celestial being' but felt its presence, a touch on his shoulder, and heard a voice.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'I need to send you back, your work is not done on earth yet,' the voice said. ... I simply said, 'I'll go.'
